findings: -ся se caracteriza como decausativo/intransitivizador, pero sus usos abarcan reflexividad, pasiva, reciprocidad y lexicalización. La entrada necesita fuentes de gramática para delimitar esta acepción y evitar presentar la causa como simplemente omitida.

Cornell cautions that -ся has multiple meanings and is not predictable; it calls such verbs intransitive. APA 7/localizador: Leed, R. L., Nakhimovsky, A. D., & Nakhimovsky, A. (1991). Beginning Russian grammar: Verbs ending in -ся: meaning and usage. Cornell University. https://russian.cornell.edu/grammar/html/gr10_a_a.htm Locator: States reflexive -ся verbs may have reflexive, reciprocal, passive, or no particular categorical meaning and are intransitive; warns meaning is not predictable.
